title: [Day 05] Input events: mouse, click, scroll, input, resize
text:
@cursor Part 1 of 5 for issue #5: [Day 05] Input events: mouse, click, scroll, input, resize. (Re-launch: the first launch did not start because of a billing limit.)

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts and QA), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue, then do ONLY Part 1.

Work test-first: a test commit `test(recorder): add throttle utility (#5)`, then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Add `packages/recorder/src/utils/throttle.ts` with leading and trailing edge options and a `cancel()`.

Requirements:
- Works with fake timers
- Trailing call gets the last arguments

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- Tests for leading, trailing, both, cancel

Implementation commit message: `feat(recorder): add throttle utility (#5)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself: `git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@users.noreply.github.com" commit --trailer "Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>" ...`.

If you make a decision a reviewer might question, add an ADR in docs/decisions/ and update docs/decisions/README.md.
